response: There is no additional value of using somatostatin receptor subtype 2a immunohistochemistry compared to somatostatin receptor scintigraphy uptake in predicting gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumor response. According to the studies, sst2a IHC of tumor samples has no additional value compared to SRS uptake using OctreoScan in predicting tumor response after PRRT. This suggests that somatostatin receptor scintigraphy uptake is sufficient for predicting tumor response, and the use of somatostatin receptor subtype 2a immunohistochemistry does not provide any additional benefit.
